In five-dimensional [[geometry]], a '''truncated 5-orthoplex''' is a convex [[uniform 5-polytope]], being a [[Truncation (geometry)|truncation]] of the regular [[5-orthoplex]].

There are 4 unique truncations of the 5-orthoplex. Vertices of the truncation 5-orthoplex are located as pairs on the edge of the 5-orthoplex. Vertices of the [[bitruncated]] 5-orthoplex are located on the triangular faces of the 5-orthoplex. The third and fourth truncations are more easily constructed as second and first truncations of the [[5-cube]].

=== Alternate names ===
* Truncated pentacross
* Truncated triacontaditeron (Acronym: tot) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/tot.htm (x3x3o3o4o - tot)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of a truncated 5-orthoplex, centered at the origin, are all 80 vertices are sign (4) and coordinate (20) [[permutation]]s of
: (±2,±1,0,0,0)

=== Images ===
The truncated 5-orthoplex is constructed by a [[Truncation (geometry)|truncation]] operation applied to the [[5-orthoplex]]. All edges are shortened, and two new vertices are added on each original edge.

{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t34|120}}

The '''bitruncated 5-orthoplex''' can [[tessellation|tessellate]] space in the [[tritruncated 5-cubic honeycomb]].

=== Alternate names ===
* Bitruncated pentacross
* Bitruncated triacontaditeron (Acronym: bittit) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/bittit.htm (o3x3x3o4o - bittit)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of a truncated 5-orthoplex, centered at the origin, are all 80 vertices are sign and coordinate [[permutation]]s of
: (±2,±2,±1,0,0)

=== Images ===
The bitruncated 5-orthoplex is constructed by a [[bitruncation]] operation applied to the [[5-orthoplex]].

{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t23|120}}

== Related polytopes ==
The truncated 5-orthoplex and bitruncated 5-orthoplex are from the family of 31 [[uniform 5-polytope]]s generated from the regular [[5-cube]] or [[5-orthoplex]].

{{Penteract family}}
